ValidationRule.description: Make Mandate reason when they select specific lost reason mentioned below. Too poor speed of execution Declined for credit reasons Not available for financing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Lost_Reason__c , "Too poor speed of execution"), ISPICKVAL( Lost_Reason__c , "Declined for credit reasons"), ISPICKVAL( Lost_Reason__c , "Not available for financing") ), ISPICKVAL( Reason__c , "")), true, false)
